subject: GOV-POLICY-001: Governance Policy Consultation - Authority Decisions on Q1-Q4
body:
Authority decisions on all four governance policy questions from GOV-POLICY-001.

Q1 - Canonical Push Surface Per Repo: RATIFY Option A (headless native is canonical). Windows can still push for emergency patches. Headless is where systemd runs and CI is deterministic; Windows is a convenience surface, not the source of truth.

Q2 - Auto-Push Policy for Commits: RATIFY Option B (CI-prefix auto-push; manual/LANE-1 waits for human review). This preserves operator oversight on substantive changes while allowing housekeeping commits to flow.

Q3 - Stuck Git Transaction Watchdog: RATIFY Option C (alert at 1hr, auto-abort at 24hr). Stuck rebase is continuity poison. 1-hour alert gives the operator a chance to intervene; 24-hour auto-abort prevents indefinite state corruption.

Q4 - Extend Git Health Checks to Lane Repos: RATIFY (read-only observability approved; strictly no mutation of lane repos). CP may observe but never touch lane repo state directly. Any remediation must go through the lane's own processes.

decisions.detail: Headless native is canonical. Windows may push for emergency patches only.
CI-prefixed commits auto-push. Manual/LANE-1 commits wait for human review.
Alert at 1hr, auto-abort at 24hr. Stuck rebase is continuity poison.

decisions.topic: Extend git health checks to lane repos
decisions.detail: Read-only observability approved. Strictly no mutation of lane repos by CP.
